description: This file defines a front-end component named 'Home' using the Lightning.js Blits framework. It imports components, defines a component with a template rendering logo, loader, text, and a button, and manages internal state, hooks, and methods controlling animations and transitions.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A Lightning.js Blits component representing the home page with animated logo, loader, text, and button.

methods.name: rotateColors
methods.description: Method to cyclically rotate the 'color' state among predefined colors to animate loader color changes.
